generatedProse.practice-connection:
You now have a way of working that will serve you in every subject from here on. Each time you present, you have the chance to own your evidence and defend it; each time you work in a team, to listen, adapt and carry your share; each reflection, to judge your performance and name what you gained. The habit to keep is simple: argue from your evidence, work well with others, and learn from each round.

That same habit carries into professional life. Wherever you present your work, collaborate with others, and reflect on how it went, the people who get better are the ones who treat each round as feeding the next. The skills you have practised here are ones you will use long after you graduate.
